name: Nightmare
description: A tentacled gelatinous being with ghostly heads in its mouth that Jace dissolves by removing the dreamers' fear.

description_citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
description_citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A tentacled nightmare crawls from the basement wall toward Jace and Kaito.
timeline.quote: some terrible, shapeless, tentacled thing began to crawl out and into the room where they both stood.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace reads the nightmare's mind and says it is a nightmare given substance.
timeline.quote: This is a nightmare given substance.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito deflects its tentacle with a wall of floor debris.
timeline.quote: the little flecks of stone that littered the floor rose up in a wall of debris that blocked the strike

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace dissolves the nightmare by taking away the dreamers' fear.
timeline.quote: I reached into the dreamers I felt inside it and took their fears away.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.
